claim_boundary: SFV2 automates skill intake, shortlist, single-vs-multi decision, role-ablation queue, catalog writeback candidates, and runtime apply review packets.
SFV2 does not turn internal HEEP/MAT-B evidence into public benchmark or publication-ready claims.
Runtime defaults remain gated by runtime-confirmed selected/injected/used/evidence/gate/outcome receipts and provider-token truth.

M2_capability_shortlist.gate: current primary and challenger shortlist generated

M3_single_skill_tournament.gate: single-skill decision states derived from MAT-B

M4_multi_role_ablation.gate: role-drop matrices generated for every non-solo assembly

M8_public_gate_separation.evidence: internal SFV2/HEEP evidence remains separate from public benchmark claims
